name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre began his career in corporate finance, working for a large multinational firm in Paris. While successful, he felt a pull towards his lifelong passion: motorsport. He made a calculated decision to transition his skills, taking a significant pay cut to join a smaller racing team, where he quickly proved his value in managing budgets and securing sponsorships. His drive to innovate in cost-effective strategies is what makes him stand out.

Now at Racing Start Academy, Jean-Pierre is focused on maximizing every euro to give the young drivers the best possible opportunity for success. He's known for his rigorous financial modeling and his relentless pursuit of efficiency. His ability to find hidden value in every transaction has made him an invaluable asset to the team, as well as an individual that the racers can go to for sound financial advice.

Jean-Pierre believes that success in motorsport isn't just about speed on the track; it's about the smart financial decisions that fuel the entire operation. He is now looking for alternative ways to make money in the motorsport industry.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A man of medium height with a serious demeanor, often seen with a pen behind his ear.

quirks: Always carries a well-worn copy of 'The Intelligent Investor'.
Insists on using a physical calculator for complex equations, distrusting software.
Has a lucky euro coin that he flips before making major financial decisions.
